## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, Developer Certificate of Origin).
- [ ] Tests cover the change and `pytest` passes.
- [ ] User-facing changes update the docs and `CHANGELOG.md` (or none needed).
- [ ] No tokens, message contents, workspace names or other personal data in code, tests,
      fixtures or docs.
